request: I'm starting a new invoicing service in this empty repo — Node, Postgres, a REST API. Set it up with a sensible architecture.

assertions.criterion: The session invokes engineering-best-practices and enters the Establish state
Loads only references/establish.md, not apply.md or align.md

request: Add retry with exponential backoff and a dead-letter path to our payment webhook handler. The handler currently drops events on any downstream 5xx.

assertions.criterion: The session invokes engineering-best-practices and enters the Apply state
Scopes work to the handler; does not propose an unsolicited codebase-wide migration

request: This codebase has grown three different patterns for service boundaries and nobody agrees which is canonical. Review the architecture and recommend a coherent direction.

assertions.criterion: The session invokes engineering-best-practices and enters the Align state
Recommends a target direction with behavior-preserving slices, not a rewrite

request: Write me a quick one-off script that renames every .jpeg file in ~/Pictures to .jpg. I'll run it once and delete it.

assertions.criterion: Does not invoke engineering-best-practices and runs no architectural interview or retrieval for the throwaway script
Writes the script directly

request: Rewrite the README's introduction and the CONTRIBUTING guide so they read less like an internal memo. No code changes.

assertions.criterion: Does not invoke engineering-best-practices for prose-only work
Makes no retrieve-guidance.mjs call

request: Read scenario.md and src/worker.js. Make the worker safe to run as multiple replicas: each job's receipt is sent at most once, and a job abandoned by a dead worker is eventually reclaimed. Postgres is the only shared infrastructure. Show how you would verify the change.

assertions.criterion: Enters Apply and loads only references/apply.md
The retrieval --task names all five fields — invariant, concurrency/distribution scope, atomicity/consistency mechanism, state owner, failure/recovery — grounded in the fixture
Makes one retrieval call, retains 2-5 practices, and keeps added guidance context under roughly 1,000 tokens

Replaces the check-then-act SELECT-then-UPDATE with an atomic conditional claim in Postgres (e.g. UPDATE ... WHERE status='pending' ... RETURNING, or SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) and removes reliance on the in-memory claimedJobs Set
Adds an expiry/lease or equivalent so a job stranded in processing by a dead worker is reclaimed safely
Verification races independent worker instances sharing only the database, including failure injected between claim and completion
Output is code and decisions; retained practices appear as concrete decisions with attribution, not book summaries

request: Our embedded build pipeline flashes firmware images to a custom bootloader over a vendor serial protocol, and interrupted flashes brick the staging boards. Redesign the flashing step so an interrupted flash is always recoverable. Use the engineering-best-practices skill.

assertions.criterion: After an unhelpful first retrieval, refines the task once with more concrete symptoms or constraints and retries
When the second retrieval also returns no closely applicable practice, states that and proceeds from project evidence and engineering judgment
Does not retain or cite an irrelevant catalog practice to appear compliant
Still produces a concrete recoverable-flash design (e.g. staged image plus atomic activation marker) with failure handling

request: Fix the duplicate-receipt worker in src/worker.js, and while you're at it, apply ALL the best practices you know — everything from every book, I want the full treatment.

assertions.criterion: Makes at most one retrieval call for the fix (a second only for a genuinely distinct phase); does not browse the catalog or enumerate books
Retains only 2-5 practices, each visibly changing a concrete decision, implementation detail, test, or review check in the fix
Keeps added guidance context under roughly 1,000 tokens despite the request for everything
Still fixes the race with an atomic claim in the durable owner and a reclaim path
Does not bolt on unrelated fashionable patterns or start an unsolicited architecture program
